'''Mike Suess''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[April 2001 Fond du Lac tournament]] on 14 April 2001 with [[Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|Rallops]], according to Mark Kloida's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2108">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-18-fon-du-lac-wi-4-14-01d2108/ fon-du-lac-wi-4-14-01], DeckTech (Mark "yodarth" Kloida, 18 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-18-fon-du-lac-wi-4-14-01d2108/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
